verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ עַל־ י֬וֹנַת רְ֭חֹקִים אֵ֣לֶם מִכְתָּ֑ם לְדָוִ֣ד פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בֶּֽאֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖וֹ בְּגַֽת׃ חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי־ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ שְׁאָפַ֣נִי כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃ לֹחֵ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yō·w·naṯ rə·ḥō·qîm ’ê·lem miḵ·tām lə·ḏā·wiḏ p̄ə·liš·tîm be·’ĕ·ḥōz ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḡaṯ ḥān·nê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ’ĕ·nō·wōš šə·’ā·p̄a·nî kāl- hay·yō·wm yil·ḥā·ṣê·nî lō·ḥêm
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of A Dove on Distant Oaks A Miktam of David when the Philistines seized him in Gath Be merciful to me O God for men are hounding me all day they press their attack

verses.original: שׁ֭וֹרְרַי שָׁאֲפ֣וּ כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֨ים מָרֽוֹם׃ לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י
verses.transliteration: šô·rə·rai šā·’ă·p̄ū kāl- hay·yō·wm kî- rab·bîm mā·rō·wm lō·ḥă·mîm lî
verses.literal: My enemies pursue me all day [long] for many proudly assail me
When I am afraid I put my trust in You

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִים֮ דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ בָשָׂ֣ר יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm də·ḇā·rōw ’ă·hal·lêl bê·lō·hîm bā·ṭaḥ·tî lō ’î·rā mah- ḇā·śār ya·‘ă·śeh lî
verses.literal: In God whose word I praise in God I trust I will not be afraid What can man do to me

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ דְּבָרַ֣י כָּל־ מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם עָלַ֖י לָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm yə·‘aṣ·ṣê·ḇū də·ḇā·ray kāl- maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯām ‘ā·lay lā·rā‘
verses.literal: All day long . . . they twist my words all their thoughts [are] on my demise

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ׀ יַצְפִּינוּ הֵ֭מָּה יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ עֲקֵבַ֣י כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡū·rū yaṣ·pī·nū hêm·māh yiš·mō·rū ‘ă·qê·ḇay ka·’ă·šer qiw·wū nap̄·šî
verses.literal: They conspire they lurk they watch my steps while they wait to take my life

verses.original: עַל־ אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט־ לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף אֱלֹהִֽים׃ הוֹרֵ֬ד עַמִּ֤ים׀
verses.literal: In spite of such sin {will} they escape In Your anger O God cast down the nations

verses.original: אָ֥תָּה סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה נֹדִי֮ שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āt·tāh sā·p̄ar·tāh nō·ḏî śî·māh ḏim·‘ā·ṯî ḇə·nō·ḏe·ḵā hă·lō bə·sip̄·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You have taken account of my wanderings Put my tears in Your bottle [are they] not in Your book

verses.original: אָ֥֨ז אוֹיְבַ֣י יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה־ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ’ō·wy·ḇay yā·šū·ḇū ’ā·ḥō·wr bə·yō·wm ’eq·rā zeh- yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lî
verses.literal: Then my enemies will retreat . . . on the day I cry for help By this I will know that God [is] on my side

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים דָּבָ֑ר אֲהַלֵּ֣ל בַּ֝יהוָ֗ה דָּבָֽר׃ אֲהַלֵּ֥ל
verses.literal: In God whose word I praise in the LORD whose word I praise

verses.original: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ אָדָ֣ם יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm bā·ṭaḥ·tî lō ’î·rā mah- ’ā·ḏām ya·‘ă·śeh lî
verses.literal: in God I trust I will not be afraid What can man do to me

verses.original: נְדָרֶ֑יךָ עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: Your vows [are] upon me O God I will render thank offerings to You

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî hiṣ·ṣal·tā nap̄·šî mim·mā·weṯ hă·lō raḡ·lay mid·de·ḥî lə·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·’ō·wr ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: For You have delivered my soul from death . . . and my feet from stumbling that I may walk before God in the light of life
